_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
Defend Gor'shak.
Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Maste…

o.t: Beat Emberstrife till his will is broken, then place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before him and use the Orb of Draconic Energy.
Use the Flames of the Black Flight over it to create the Seal.

quests.t: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken. It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must t…

o.t: Combine Omokk's Head with the Roughshod Pike.
Use it to instantly kill one nearby ogre.

quests.t: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.
Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Satu…
Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

quests.t: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson. Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!
Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to ea…
Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.
Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.
Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.
Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.
You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley. Kill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at Frostwolf Keep.
You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley. Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated. Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the f…
Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.
Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.
Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.
Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.

You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence. The last step before retu…
Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul. According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.

Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each. Return to Keeper Remulos in the Moonglade when you have completed this task.
Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.
Take the Green Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
Arygos in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring him Imperial Qiraji Armaments and 3 Elementium Ore.
Merithra of the Dream in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring her Imperial Qiraji Regalia and 3 Elementium Ore.
Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing. Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.
Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.
Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Cinder of Cynders, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.
Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
Speak with Mokvar at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
